subject: English
passage: In recent years, marine biologists around the world have developed new technologies that monitor the health of coral reef ecosystems. Scientists in Australia, for example, use an Aquatic Health Scanner. This device ______ water temperature, acidity levels, and marine biodiversity.
prompt: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanation: Choice C is the best answer. The previous sentence tells us how scientists in Australia "use" a certain device, while this sentence describes general facts about that device. To express general facts (and also to match the simple present tense of "use"), we should use the simple present tense form "measures."
